Charles Tolliver was born in Jacksonville, Florida in 1942. He has made his mark in the jazz world as a trumpet player, composer, and co-founder of Strata- East Records Charles was interviewed via Zoom on May 6, 2021 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m very pleased, at 10 AM in the morning (not a jazz musician’s time usually) but to have Charles Tolliver as a guest today. Thank you for joining me.
Before I started recording you said you had a lot of tasks but they were all in music — so I’m curious what projects you’re able to pursue during this basic time of most things being shut down?

Well it’s been a challenge as you can imagine. Basically for the last year and five months all of us have been experiencing this. It’s been going out every few days to get provisions, coming back in the house and dealing with as much music as one can to, you know, stay sane I guess.
